relations.statement: gramStd deltaTrueInt deltaTrueInt = 1, gramWeighted deltaTrueInt deltaTrueInt = 2, and the two values differ: two distinct admissible Gram forms on the same carrier
relations.hypotheses: none (closed computation on Vec Int Bool)

relations.statement: sesq intPack enumBool deltaTrueInt deltaTrueInt = 1 while gramWeighted deltaTrueInt deltaTrueInt = 2, plus an F2 sesq clause: the inner product is admitted as a choice, not derived
over the F2 pack the sesq pairing admits a nonzero isotropic vector (oneOneF2 pairs to zero with itself), so sesq alone is not an inner product for every scalar pack
relations.hypotheses: none (exact statement not shown in @SRC signature)

relations.statement: delta basis vectors are orthonormal for the standard Gram form
relations.hypotheses: none (exact statement not shown in @SRC signature)

lemmas.statement: On the carrier Vec Int Bool there exist two Gram forms gramStd and gramWeighted that disagree on deltaTrueInt (values 1 and 2); hence a Hilbert inner product on the linearized carrier is not uniquely determined and must be admitted.
Both gramStd and gramWeighted are positive definite on nonzero vectors of Vec Int Bool, so the positivity requirement does not select a unique inner product.
gramWeighted deltaTrueInt deltaTrueInt - gramStd deltaTrueInt deltaTrueInt = 1

open FableHilbertWalk20260819.H005 in
theorem gram_values_differ_by_one : gramWeighted deltaTrueInt deltaTrueInt - gramStd deltaTrueInt deltaTrueInt = 1 := by
  have h := gram_not_unique
  sorry

near_misses.claim: Requiring a positive-definite form on Vec Int Bool determines the inner product uniquely.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: gramStd_pos_def and gramWeighted_pos_def both hold while gram_not_unique shows the forms differ on deltaTrueInt (1 vs 2).

near_misses.claim: sesq P E is an inner product (anisotropic) for every StarRingPack P.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: f2_isotropic: with the F2 pack, oneOneF2 is nonzero yet pairs to zero with itself.

near_misses.claim: Orthonormality of the delta basis under gramStd (delta_orthonormal) implies every admissible Gram form is gramStd.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: gramWeighted gives deltaTrueInt norm 2, contradicting uniqueness while still admissible (positive definite).
